## Signal type

A Signal is some information emitted from within Holochain out through an Interface

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Signal = {
    type: "app";
    value: {
        cell_id: CellId;
        zome_name: ZomeName;
        signal: AppSignal;
    };
} | {
    type: "app_direct";
    value: {
        cell_id: CellId;
        signal: Array<number>;
    };
} | {
    type: "system";
    value: SystemSignal;
};
```
